title: New rules on keeping clients informed about their complaints proposed
summary: The SRA has proposed rules that would require firms to give clients a timeline for resolving a complaint and regular updates on its progress. Final proposals go to the LSB for approval.
what_changes: When a complaint is first made, firms would have to give the client a timeline for resolving it.
Firms would have to give clients regular updates on how their complaint is progressing.
A new Complaints Handling Requirements Statement would explain the existing and new complaints rules.
These rules add to 2025 proposals that would make firms' complaints information clearer and easier for clients to find.
who_it_applies_to: All SRA-regulated law firms that deal with complaints from clients.

history.event: Consultation on more complaints-handling rules opened, running from 3 July to 1 September 2026.
